Boot recipe

pnpm workspace monorepo whose root package.json owns the dev script (`turbo run dev`, which starts the Vite renderer + Electron per the README); the only lockfile is root pnpm-lock.yaml. Turbo doesn't accept a port flag and Vite ignores PORT, so the renderer's default Vite port 5173 is the only addressable strategy; the Vite dev shell for a React 19 app is client-rendered, so the health marker is the root mount div from the raw index.html rather than any product name.
